sections.text: UK net migration fell to 77,000 in the year to June, down from 204,000 in the previous 12 months and a peak of 944,000 in 2023. sections.text: The fourth National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles found British adults are having less sex. Under-45s average sex twice a month, down from four times in 1990. sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The government is preparing to publish further documents regarding the appointment of Lord Mandelson as US ambassador. Some papers were released earlier this year after MPs voted to compel their release, while others were withheld at the request of the Metropolitan Police. The Met has now stated the files can be published without prejudicing their ongoing investigation.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Lord Mandelson was arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office and sacked after information emerged about his relationship with Jeffrey Epstein.
